creators.name: Shi Nai’an
creators.note: Work attribution; distinguish the received text and its transmission from a securely identified single historical author.

description: Distinguishes historical traces of Song Jiang and the Fang La rebellion from the novel’s 108 outlaws, spirit framework, and layered narrative tradition. Compares the 100- and 120-chapter versions, Jin Shengtan’s shortened edition and commentary, competing authorship attributions, alternative endings and their politics, surviving print witnesses, translations, and Japanese visual adaptations.

period.label: 1100–1127 CE · late Northern Song historical context
period.note: The lecture dates Huizong’s reign to 1100–1126, Fang La’s rebellion to 1120–1121, and the fall of the capital to 1127. This is historical context, not a claim that all novel episodes occurred or that the book was composed then.
